reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing local Git inspection and approved commit or branch operations, with optional Change Ledger checkpoint delegation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 Git 状态、差异、日志、提交和分支操作，并可选集成 Change Ledger 工作区检查点。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with local Git status, diff, log, commit, and branch tools, plus optional Change Ledger workspace checkpoint integration.

capabilities: Reads Git status, diffs, logs, and local branches through a shell service
Creates Git commits from existing staged changes after approval
Creates and switches local branches after approval
Optionally delegates workspace checkpoint creation and restoration to a Change Ledger service
